items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Brunny's a blue one. Yeah. They had many kazoo players around here? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, man. They had them little tub bands and. Kazoo... One guy on a kazoo... He's a good guy.

ctx.x: Yeah, well he used to play them just like he played trumpet, you know.
George Brunny's a blue one. Yeah. They had many kazoo players around here?

Yeah, man. They had them little tub bands and. Kazoo, you used to play two of them. One, like you played, like you played a planet and a trumpet. One guy on a kazoo, was like, do Do do do do. Do do do do. Do do do do. Do do do do. Do do do do. Do do do do. Do do do. Yeah. He's a good guy. Washboard and all that stuff. Sounds good too, Paul. I'm telling you, these sound good. Did you?
